checks.description: next.config.mjs wraps the export with next-intl/plugin
next-intl and next-themes are declared in package.json (layout.tsx imports both)

checks.cmd: pnpm --filter @converge/studio typecheck 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS' | xargs test 0 -eq

checks.description: pnpm dev boots within 30s and / returns 200
checks.cmd: bash -c 'cd packages/converge-studio && (pnpm dev > /tmp/converge-studio-dev.log 2>&1 &); pid=$!; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:4000/ || echo 000); if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then kill $pid 2>/dev/null; exit 0; fi; done; kill $pid 2>/dev/null; cat /tmp/converge-studio-dev.log; exit 1'
